correctness.rationale: The kernel identity computes both products exactly. Explicit Weyl displacement unitaries conjugate each to a scalar times diagonal D_q with all singular values |q|^n. The scalar modulus is computed by completing the square; the Schatten formulas follow by geometric summation. An algebraic expansion produces the Hermitian order form with determinant −|a−c|², giving its complete signature classification. q=0 is explicitly rank-one. A deterministic standalone finite checker passed 166 assertions; the proof is independent of finite computation.
